text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the tryouts, I see Copano
Rickey on the training
track.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huff! Puff! Wood, fire, earth, metal, auspicious sign! Wood, fire, earth, metal, auspicious sign!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whew... phew... That should be enough.
Next up is the woodchip
track!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! Yeah,
since I put up such a pitiful
fight in the tryouts, I
thought I should pour
even more qi into my training!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What? No, of course not. I'm not training
harder just because she told
me to.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is my everyday routine! ☆ Feng shui
doesn't grant you wishes. It
shows you
where to channel your effort!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So she does put in effort.
It sounds like she
doesn't leave everything
up to feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My big loss in the tryouts hasn't changed
my willingness to train hard,
but it did get
me thinking... And I've realized that I've
got to change some things up!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm still shocked I couldn't hear the
earth's
voice. If this keeps up, how
am I supposed
to be useful to anyone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time I've heard her talk
about being useful to others.
She must
have a reason for racing that I don't know
about.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sure! I've got plenty. ♪ I was just
about to take a break anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We walk as we talk, until we end up at the
park nearby the academy.

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rickey! It's great to see you! Thanks
for your advice last time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hi! How's the Chinese restaurant doing?
Did the advice work?

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, business is booming! After I moved the
trees in the garden and
got orange ramen
bowls like you said...

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
The ambience must have improved,
because customers started
flowing in.
Thanks to that, I finally got my bedridden
father on board.

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
I understand that he wants to keep the
shop looking the old-fashioned way, but
it's also important to have the courage to

change sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I can continue the shop he passed
down to me. Even a long-time customer
who's known me since I was a kid shed a
tear of
joy for us.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's great news! The shop closing
down wouldn't have made
anyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Blowing wind is better than sitting and
waiting! If I gave you even a
little bit of
courage, then I'm glad!

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
You did! I'll come to you again for more
feng shui advice for my old
man and my
regulars!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The restaurant owner walks away, bowing
all the way.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, as you can see, feng shui can pull you
out of tough spots and help
you make
decisions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's worked for me, and I've seen it work
for lots of other Umamusume too. A gentle
push from feng shui can be all it takes
for things to go
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want more people to know
about feng shui—I want everyone to be
happy! It empowers you to avoid
misfortune and
invite happiness!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've got to win races and prove
how powerful it is to
everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That might be a bit of an exaggeration,
but of course I want to see
everyone
happy. Don't you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But nobody will be convinced if I can't
win.
I can't believe I couldn't
hear the earth's
voice during such an important race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm impressed by her desire to help
others,
but I'm still curious...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that? Well, I call it a voice,
but it's not
like I actually hear a
voice. That's just what
it feels like.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was in elementary school the first
time I
heard the earth's voice. It
was sports day,
and I was in the middle of a race...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It was like the earth was telling me
how to run from its perspective. I
could feel the
flow of qi and predict my opponents' next
moves. Thanks to that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I went on a winning streak. By having my
body become one with nature and all of
creation, I knew exactly how to race and
finished
first every time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't hear that voice in the
tryouts the other day. Maybe I
was too nervous, or
maybe I didn't prepare the space enough 
beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is about becoming one with
nature, but for some reason, it
felt distant.
I couldn't do it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks troubled, so I want to do
something to help. If it's nature
she wants
to feel closer to, then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh, a trip? Where do you have in mind?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yay, a picnic! ♪ I needed this change of
pace! Mind if I shout into the
mountains?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Super happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bring Copano Rickey to the mountains,
thinking this might be the perfect place
for her to figure out why she lost touch
with the earth's
voice.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! In places like this,
it's easy to see
the dragon veins. The flow of
qi feels so
full of life!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Can't you feel the qi flowing along
the mountain ridges? Those
are the dragon
veins!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The exit of a dragon vein is called a
dragon hollow. When the qi from the
mountains comes down to the beach and
erupts, that location becomes a power
spot.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: If I concentrate...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can sense it strongly today...
The dragon
hollow's qi is swirling with
energy,
enveloping everything.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even if I close my eyes.
I can see the whole
shore. And the earth's
voice is as clear to
me as ever.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I feel nature right now, so there's
nothing wrong with my senses.
So why
couldn't I hear its voice during the
tryouts?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Good question. If it's not a problem with
her senses, then why can she
hear the
earth's voice at the beach, but not on the
racetrack?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said she went undefeated at her
elementary school's sports day,
which
means she could connect to the voice on
school grounds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So she can hear it on the school grounds
and at the beach, but not on the
racetrack.
Could that be the key to finding
the answer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to pinpoint what sets the track
apart
using my limited knowledge
of feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Cracked what?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: What?! Really?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If my predictions are correct...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then she should be able to show off her
full power in the next race.
